description: We are Butterfly Tech Stars, a team of enthusiastic students passionate about Artificial Intelligence, science, and technology. Our project, AI Butterfly, explores an innovative AI-based system using a simulated butterfly, AI chip, wireless communication (TX and RX), and battery-powered motor. We believe in creativity, teamwork, learning, and developing innovative technological solutions.
summary: AI Butterfly is an innovative project that combines Artificial Intelligence with a simulated butterfly system. It uses an AI chip for processing, signal transmission through TX and RX communication, and a battery-powered motor system. The project demonstrates how AI and electronic components can work together to create an intelligent and innovative system.
